ask: mkae a calender of all the dates plz
sentence: A shared two-month calendar (November and December) that lists the group's upcoming dates, lets each person mark going or undo, and lets anyone add or remove a date.
use_when: The group wants one place to see all upcoming dates from the chat
People need to say whether they are going to each event
Someone wants to add a deadline, party, or trip date to a shared list
dont_use_when: The group needs to pick a date or time by voting, which needs a poll or scheduler
The dates fall outside November and December
The request is for a personal reminder or alarm, or a split of costs
